findings.note: Bears slot CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) is out for a second straight game and RB Roschon Johnson (ankle) is also out, while Detroit is undefeated at home and on a six-game win streak; Chicago has won five straight and has not trailed since Caleb Williams returned.

Detroit's defensive line is depleted: Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL, DT Skyler Gill-Howard is out for the season, and EDGE DJ Wonnum (back) is a game-time decision. Chicago also lost backup S Elijah Hicks to a concussion, and the page lists the game as Bears at Lions (+2.5).

The Bears' own preview says Detroit has allowed only 14.4 points per game over its last five even without Jack Campbell and Hutchinson, and its offense is fifth in scoring, with Gibbs leading the NFL in rushing yards and touchdowns. That is a tough test for Chicago's thinned secondary.
